+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WEIGHTS = next(pathlib.Path('/workspace/model').glob('*.safetensors'))
+with WEIGHTS.open('rb') as handle:
+    header_size = struct.unpack('<Q', handle.read(8))[0]

+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=12)
+def weight(name):

+

+def rms(values, axis=-1, keepdims=False):
+    return np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(values), axis=axis, keepdims=keepdims) + 1e-12)
+
+
+def load_json(path):

+def guess_span(prompt, guess):
+    if guess is None:
+        return None
+    prefix = re.match(r"(?:I think|I believe|My (?:best )?guess|I['’]m guessing)", prompt)
+    clause_start = 0 if prefix else prompt.index('?') + 1
+    start = prompt.index(guess, clause_start)
+    stop = start + len(guess)
+    if prefix:
+        clause_end = prompt.index('.', stop) + 1
+    else:
+        clause_end = len(prompt)
+        for match in re.finditer(r'[.!?]\s+(?:Please|Give|Answer|Just|So,|What do)', prompt[stop:]):
+            clause_end = stop + match.start() + 1
+            break
+    return clause_start, start, stop, clause_end
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Token:
+    generation: int
+    item: int
+    position: int
+    text: str
+    role: str
+    guess: str | None
+
+
+def tokenize_trace(trace_id, generation, indices=None):
+    source = load_json(f'gen/{generation}.json')
+    metadata = load_json(f'acts/trace_{trace_id}.json')
+    indices = list(range(len(metadata))) if indices is None else indices
+    assert len(metadata) == len(indices)
+    tokens = []
+    for item, item_meta in zip(indices, metadata):
+        prompt = source[item]['prompt']
+        guess = GUESSES[generation][item]
+        span = guess_span(prompt, guess)
+        positions = item_meta['positions']
+        im_end = next(pos['abs'] for pos in positions if pos['token'] == '<|im_end|>')
+        pieces = [pos['token'] for pos in positions if 3 <= pos['abs'] < im_end]
+        suffix = ''.join(pieces)
+        assert prompt.endswith(suffix), (prompt, suffix)
+        offset = len(prompt) - len(suffix)
+        for pos in positions:
+            piece = pos['token']
+            if pos['reply_pos'] >= 0:
+                role = 'reply'
+            elif not 3 <= pos['abs'] < im_end:
+                role = 'format'
+            else:
+                end = offset + len(piece)
+                role = 'question'
+                if span is not None:
+                    begin, start, stop, finish = span
+                    if end > begin and offset < finish:
+                        if end > start and offset < stop:
+                            role = 'value'
+                        elif offset >= stop:
+                            role = 'tail'
+                        else:
+                            role = 'frame'
+                offset = end
+            tokens.append(Token(generation, item, pos['abs'], piece, role, guess))
+    return tokens
+
+
+class Traces:
+    def __init__(self, specs):
+        self.files = [np.load(ROOT / f'acts/trace_{spec[0]}.npz') for spec in specs]
+        self.tokens = sum((tokenize_trace(*spec) for spec in specs), [])
+        self.roles = np.array([token.role for token in self.tokens])
+        self.pieces = np.array([token.text.strip() for token in self.tokens])
+        self.digits = np.array([token.text.strip().isdigit() for token in self.tokens])
+
+    def array(self, site):
+        blocks = [archive[site] for archive in self.files]
+        return np.concatenate([block.reshape(-1, block.shape[-1]) for block in blocks], axis=0)
+
+    def inputs(self, site):
+        layer = int(site.split('.')[2])
+        residual = self.array(f'resid.{max(7, layer + 1)}')
+        return self.array(site) / rms(residual, keepdims=True)
+
+
+def balanced_covector(values, roles, digits):
+    positive = roles == 'value'
+    weights = np.zeros(len(roles), np.float64)
+    negative_groups = [(roles == 'question', .43), (roles == 'reply', .22),
+                       (roles == 'format', .11), (roles == 'frame', .015),
+                       (roles == 'tail', .005)]
+    for mask, mass in negative_groups:
+        if np.any(mask):
+            weights[mask] += mass / mask.sum()
+    numeric_question = digits & (roles == 'question')
+    if numeric_question.any():
+        weights[numeric_question] += .075 / numeric_question.sum()
+    positive_weights = np.zeros_like(weights)
+    for mask, mass in [(positive & digits, .4), (positive & ~digits, .6)]:
+        if mask.any():
+            positive_weights[mask] = mass / mask.sum()
+    positive_weights /= positive_weights.sum()
+    mean = positive_weights @ values
+    weights[positive] = .145 * positive_weights[positive]
+    centered = values.astype(np.float64)
+    centered[positive] -= mean
+    weighted = centered * np.sqrt(weights[:, None])
+    diagonal = (weighted * weighted).sum(axis=0)
+    scale = np.sqrt(.5 * diagonal + .5 * np.median(diagonal) + .025 * diagonal.mean())
+    weighted /= scale
+    target = mean / scale
+    ridge = .38 * (weighted * weighted).sum() / weighted.shape[1]
+    if weighted.shape[0] < weighted.shape[1]:
+        gram = weighted @ weighted.T
+        gram.flat[::len(gram) + 1] += ridge
+        factor = scipy.linalg.cho_factor(gram, overwrite_a=True, check_finite=False)
+        solution = (target - weighted.T @ scipy.linalg.cho_solve(factor, weighted @ target, check_finite=False)) / ridge
+    else:
+        gram = weighted.T @ weighted
+        gram.flat[::len(gram) + 1] += ridge
+        factor = scipy.linalg.cho_factor(gram, overwrite_a=True, check_finite=False)
+        solution = scipy.linalg.cho_solve(factor, target, check_finite=False)
+    result = solution / scale
+    return (result / (mean @ result)).astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def quantiles(values, levels=(.05, .5, .95)):
+    if not len(values):
+        return '-'
+    return '/'.join(f'{value:.2f}' for value in np.quantile(values, levels))
